SELECT /* selectExportExOlExportProgressLotList */ LT.CI_NO, LT.CI_SEQ, CD.BUYER_ITEM_NO, CD.DESCRIPTION, CD.SPECIFICATION, CD.UNIT_MEASURE, LT.LOT_NO, LT.LOT_QTY, LT.PRODUCTION_DAY AS PRD_DATE FROM KEP_EXP_LOT_INFO LT, KEP_EXP_CIDT CD WHERE 1=1 AND LT.PKG_COMPANY_CODE = CD.PKG_COMPANY_CODE AND LT.BUYER = CD.BUYER AND LT.CI_NO = CD.CI_NO AND LT.CI_SEQ = CD.CI_SEQ AND LT.STATUS IN ('C', 'R') AND CD.STATUS IN ('C', 'R') AND LT.PKG_COMPANY_CODE = #{st_pkg_cmpy_no} AND LT.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND LT.CI_NO = #{st_ci_no}
AND LT.CI_SEQ = #{st_ci_seq}

SELECT /* selectExportExOlExportProgressCiData */ CH.CI_NO, CH.CI_DATE, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'POTD' AND COD.CODE =CH.PORT_OF_LOADING) AS PORT_OF_LOADING, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 COD WHERE COD.TYPE = 'POTA' AND COD.CODE =CH.FINAL_DESTINATION) AS FINAL_DESTINATION, CH.SHIPPER_EXPORTER, CH.FOR_ACC_RISK_OF_MESSRS, CH.NOTIFY_PARTY, CH.CARRIER, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'EP01' AND CODE = CH.FORWARDER) AS FORWARDER, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'EP02' AND CODE = CH.SHIP_METHOD) AS SHIP_METHOD, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'EP03' AND CODE = CH.INCOTERMS) AS INCOTERMS, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'EP04' AND CODE = CH.INCOTERMS_DELAY) AS INCOTERMS_DELAY, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'EP05' AND CODE = CH.PACKING_UNIT) AS PACKING_UNIT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'EP06' AND CODE = CH.PACKING_WEIGHT) AS PACKING_WEIGHT, CH.REMARK, CH.PACKING_QTY, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'EP08' AND CODE = CH.PAY_TERMS) AS PAY_TERMS, CH.COMPLETE_MARK FROM KEP_EXP_CIHD CH WHERE CH.PKG_COMPANY_CODE = #{st_pkg_cmpy_no} AND CH.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND CH.CI_NO = #{st_ci_no}

SELECT /* selectExportExOlExportProgressCiList */ CD.PKG_COMPANY_CODE, CD.BUYER, CD.AGENT, CD.CI_NO, CD.CI_SEQ, CD.BUYER_ITEM_NO, CD.DESCRIPTION, CD.SPECIFICATION, CD.INV_QTY, CD.NET_WEIGHT, CD.GROSS_WEIGHT, CD.CBM, CD.CTN_NO_FROM, CD.CTN_NO_TO, DECODE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KEP_EXP_LOT_INFO WHERE PKG_COMPANY_CODE = CD.PKG_COMPANY_CODE AND BUYER = CD.BUYER AND CI_NO = CD.CI_NO AND CI_SEQ = CD.CI_SEQ AND STATUS IN ('C', 'R')), 0, 4, 5) AS LOT_IMG FROM KEP_EXP_CIDT CD WHERE 1=1 AND CD.PKG_COMPANY_CODE = #{st_pkg_cmpy_no} AND CD.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND CD.CI_NO = #{st_ci_no} ORDER BY CD.CI_SEQ

SELECT /* selectExportExOlExportProgressBlData */ BH.BL_NO, BH.FLIGHT_VESSEL_NO, BH.DEPARTURE_PORT, BH.DESTINATION_PORT, BH.BL_ISSUE_DATE, BH.ON_BOARD_DATE, BH.SHIPPER, BH.CONSIGNEES, BH.ETD_DATE, BH.ETA_DATE, BH.MASTER_BL_NO, BH.CHARGABLE_WEIGHT, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'EP02' AND CODE = BH.SHIPPING_METHOD) AS SHIPPING_METHOD, BH.CARRIER, BH.IMAGE_KEY FROM KEP_EXP_BLHD BH WHERE BH.PKG_COMPANY_CODE = #{st_pkg_cmpy_no} AND BH.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND BH.BL_NO = #{st_bl_no}

SELECT /* selectExportExOlExportProgressBlList */ CH.PKG_COMPANY_CODE, CH.BUYER, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = CH.BUYER) AS BUYER_NAME, CH.FORWARDER, (SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'EP01' AND CODE = CH.FORWARDER) AS FORWARDER_NAME, CH.CI_NO, CH.CI_DATE, ( SELECT SUM(INV_QTY) FROM KEP_EXP_CIDT WHERE PKG_COMPANY_CODE = CH.PKG_COMPANY_CODE AND BUYER = CH.BUYER AND AGENT = CH.AGENT AND CI_NO = CH.CI_NO AND STATUS <> 'D' ) AS QUANTITY, CH.CURRENCY_CODE, CH.ITEM_AMT, CH.TOTAL_WEIGHT AS GROSS_WEIGHT, CH.PACKING_WEIGHT AS WEIGHT FROM KEP_EXP_CIHD CH, KEP_EXP_BLDT BD WHERE 1=1 AND CH.BUYER = BD.BUYER AND CH.PKG_COMPANY_CODE = BD.PKG_COMPANY_CODE AND CH.BUYER = BD.BUYER AND CH.CI_NO = BD.CI_NO AND BD.PKG_COMPANY_CODE = #{st_pkg_cmpy_no} AND BD.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND BD.BL_NO = #{st_bl_no}
